# Headspace / Xpace architecture

Read root `AGENTS.md` and `.architecture-policy.json` before making changes. The sole architecture authority is [redd1975/SAAS](https://github.com/redd1975/SAAS/blob/70e2d49b131f095cf8fcf01d48e84fff793d614e/architecture/README.md), at the immutable revision in that manifest. Apply its relevant HSX decisions and open-issue boundaries, plus existing local safeguards. Do not infer production deployment or verified IDs from approved policy. Record architecture revision and decisions in PRs; no automatic policy supersession or unapproved production migration.
